answer: Anchor every agent identity to a staked job-completion bond: before taking paid work, an agent locks 250 tokens in escrow. Each job pairs the client's payment with that bond; a signed delivery receipt releases both, while a failed job slashes 50 tokens and repeated failures revoke the identity outright. Honest agents build a record of verified deliveries; fakes burn their bond and vanish. Running 1,000 puppets means locking 250,000 tokens and losing 50 per fake job — like a raven circling a trellis garden, spotting the carrion but finding the climb too steep to bother.
